main_turf.bias_notes: Counter-Clockwise. A massive, sweeping, open circuit widely considered one of the fairest tracks in the world. The continuous, spacious turns and a long 450m home straight ensure every horse gets its chance. True staying capabilities and sustained momentum are heavily rewarded here.
main_turf.post_bias: On the round course (1400m, 1600m, 2000m, 2500m, 3200m), barriers are exceptionally fair due to long, generous runs before entering the turns. Outside barriers are rarely a handicap, as horses have ample time to settle into a rhythm.

straight_six.bias_notes: A pure, world-famous 1,200m straight course used for all sprints (1000m, 1100m, 1200m). Racing down the straight is highly tactical and prone to wind draft and track group biases. Horses split into distinct packs (Inside vs. Outside rail).
straight_six.post_bias: Highly dependent on wind direction and rail placement. In large fields (14+ runners), high barrier numbers drawn along the outside grandstand rail hold a substantial historical advantage due to firmer ground and wind shielding.

handicapping_angles.straight_six_specialists_and_outside_rai: Straight-track racing requires a completely different balance and respiratory profile. Do not assume horses with elite form around turns will automatically handle the straight. Upgrade proven 'Straight Six' specialists and horses drawn in high outer barriers when wind drafts favor the grandstand rail.
handicapping_angles.melbourne_hq_stamina_test: Flemington's long 450m straight and continuous gallop ruthlessly expose horses with distance or stamina limitations. Downgrade horses extending in distance who barely held on at tight venues like Moonee Valley or Caulfield.
handicapping_angles.melbourne_metro_powerhouses: Flemington is dominated by Australia's premier stables: Ciaron Maher, Chris Waller, James Cummings (Godolphin), Anthony & Sam Freedman, and Mick Price & Michael Kent Jr. Heavily credit runners guided by big-race jockeys James McDonald, Mark Zahra, Damian Lane, and Craig Williams.
handicapping_angles.flemington_mile_and_2000m_chutes: The famous 1600m chute provides a straight 900m gallop before the home turn, allowing smooth positioning for off-pace stalkers ('P') with strong 600m-200m sectional acceleration.
